laws.rule: From 1 January 2027, Gipuzkoa (the province that includes Donostia/San Sebastián) charges a tourist stay tax in every municipality, per person per night for up to 6 nights at the same place. Each council sets its rate within a range, and the maximum applies where a council has set none: EUR 4.50 to 6.50 at five-star hotels and in holiday rentals (about A$7.15 to A$10.33), EUR 3.50 to 5.50 at four-star hotels (A$5.56 to A$8.74), EUR 0.75 to 1.75 at campsites, hostels, guesthouses and rural houses (A$1.19 to A$2.78), and EUR 6 to 7 per cruise passenger (A$9.53 to A$11.12). Under-18s are exempt, as are people with a disability of 65% or more and one companion. Stays booked before 5 February 2026 are not taxed. AUD at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = EUR 0.6293.
